en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There used to be for Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> a musk holder. Whenever he<sup>saww</sup> performed ablution, he<sup>saww</sup> would grab it with his<sup>saww</sup> hands while wet. So when he<sup>saww</sup> went out, it would be recognised that he<sup>saww</sup> is Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> by its fragrance’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, had a musk container. When making wudu he would take it in his hand while wet. When coming out people noticed his coming because of the perfume and fragrance.’”
